Could not start the AirPlay receiver (error %1$d). Check that the Fire TV is connected to Wi-Fi and reopen the app.

Connect your iPhone to the same Wi-Fi network as this Fire TV, then either:

• In a video app (like Dreaming Spanish), tap the AirPlay button in the video player and pick this Fire TV. The video plays on the TV and you can lock your phone.

• Or open Control Center, tap Screen Mirroring and pick this Fire TV to show your whole screen.

Keep this app open on the TV. Press Back or Home to stop.
